title: ISO Tariff, Section 5

values.quote: within 20 years after commercial operation of the original connection project
a legal owner of a transmission facility is not required to refund an adjustment amount less than $10 000.

unsupported_wording: Mostly supported, with three wording points. (1) The source says 'within 20 years after commercial operation of the original connection project', not 'of the original connection'. (2) 'New participants pay a share' is softer in the source: the ISO 'may assess construction contributions to the additional market participants' (s. 5.5(6)(b)), which is discretionary. (3) The $10 000 floor applies to adjustment amounts in general (payments and refunds) and binds the legal owner of a transmission facility, not only ISO refunds to the original customer.
note: 'May' refund is supported: s. 5.5(5)(b) says the ISO 'may refund under subsection 5.6 below, where applicable, in part or in full' a contribution 'previously paid by that market participant'. The source says 'market participant', not 'customer'.
